title: Trump names Huang, Ellison, Dell Zuckerberg and more on new White House council to help 'the Golden Age of Innovation' | TechRadar
summary: The Trump administration has formed a new advisory board of top technology leaders, including CEOs from major tech companies, to guide policy on science and technology. The board, known as the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (PCAST), aims to focus on AI and innovation challenges and opportunities for the American workforce.
sentiment_reason: The formation of the PCAST advisory board with leading tech industry figures and the focus on AI and innovation are positive indicators for the tech industry and potential advancements in technology policy.
